_notes: Horde schedule. The horde clock advances only while the app is open and not paused (scaled by game speed); it is frozen while any horde (regular or bonus) is active. Horde 1 arrives firstHordeSeconds into a fresh game; each later horde arrives intervalSeconds after the previous one ENDS. day = number of the regular horde (horde 1 = day 1). warningSeconds = spawn edges are revealed (arrows) this long before arrival; the countdown is always visible. BUDGET: threatBudget = round((baseBudget + budgetPerDay * (day - 1)) * townFactor); townFactor = clamp(1 + townValue / townValueDivisor, 1, townFactorMax); townValue = scrap + food spent on buildings/upgrades still standing (stored resources and starting layout do not count, so hoarding does not make hordes bigger). COMPOSITION: pick the bracket whose day range contains day; first spawn 'guaranteed' zombies (their threatCost comes out of the budget), then fill the remaining budget by weighted random (seeded) using 'weights'. A type whose threatCost exceeds the remaining budget is skipped. SPAWN: edgeCount edges chosen by seeded random from spawnEdges (ids defined in Content/maps/phase1_exit.json); zombies split evenly across edges, one every spawnIntervalSeconds per edge. completionBonus is paid when every zombie is dead. bonusHorde = the Horde Alert horde (see offline.json for notification timing).

pathing._pathingNote: flow-field cost of a wall/building tile = currentHp * costPerHp, times the zombie's pathCostWeight; so damaged walls attract more zombies

bonusHorde._bonusNote: budget = regular budget for the current day * sizeMultiplier; lootMultiplier applies to zombie drops and completionBonus. It sits frozen at one edge until the player taps Engage. Ignoring it costs nothing.
